purpose: As-built application and UI architecture for AI-assisted consistency review and UI overhaul. This is not an exact database DDL schema.
evidenceScope: Local source inspection; published CMS data, live role assignments and all runtime theme combinations were not enumerated.

stack.frontend: React 18 with JSX, Vite, React Router, CSS files
stack.persistence: PostgreSQL with portal and CMS pool boundaries; Redis infrastructure; configured object storage
notes: Plain CSS is the dominant styling mechanism.
Utility-style class strings exist in components/ui; their presence does not establish an active Tailwind build.

surfaces.boundary: Public browsing does not initialize AuthProvider.
Authenticated surface bootstrap applies to auth routes; public header/footer are suppressed.
Resident role and account setup gate; private ownership enforced by server.

surfaces.audience: roles staff, it_support, content_manager with effective permissions
surfaces.boundary: Department membership and effective action permissions are separate requirements.

surfaces.audience: roles admin, super_admin with effective permissions
surfaces.boundary: Admin shell permission filtering does not replace backend authorization.

additionalRouteNotes: The /admin/settings entry redirects to a validated category, normally /admin/settings/general.
Legacy officials/barangay dynamic redirects and module-query redirects are handled in App.jsx and routeRegistry.js.
Wildcard fallbacks and development-only error previews are not ordinary product pages.

providers.PublicConfig: All surfaces: public configuration, ready/unavailable state and maintenance behavior.
providers.AuthContext: Authenticated surfaces: session, user, role, permissions, challenge/MFA, registration and logout.
providers.ResidentPreferencesContext: /app family: appearance, locale, contrast and preference editing. Do not assume every staff page consumes these preferences.

styling.iconPolicy: src/icon-buttons.css: explicit data-icon-button="ghost"; transparent hover/active/focus; minimum 44px hit target; preserve visible keyboard focus.
styling.themes: ResidentPreferencesContext and HTML preference attributes; light/dark/high-contrast overrides in citizen.css.
styling.importantCaveat: Stylesheet source order, specificity and !important layers affect final appearance. Earlier token definitions in citizen.css are overridden later; a hex color in source is not proof of the computed on-screen color.

workflows.caveat: Actual requests use the configured workflow revision/snapshot; these exported starting workflows are not universal transition rules. Resident labels intentionally summarize internal processing states; legacy lowercase status contracts are separate.

steps: Sign in and account setup if needed
Required servicing offices for department-access staff

conceptualDataModel.disclaimer: UI-facing domain relationships, not an exhaustive physical PostgreSQL schema.
identity: CMS staff/admin user -> employee profile -> permission groups -> group permissions/policies
Staff user -> servicing department memberships (separate from profile department text)
services: Service request -> applicant snapshot + configuration snapshot + values/documents/appointment + status/history/notes/assignments
financial: Business -> billing request/link or billing statement
Request/statement -> payment orders -> immutable charge items
Payment order -> payment attempts/gateway checkouts/verified payments
content: Media object -> usage references/private or public access rules

apiFamilies.note: Logical family label; not a literal endpoint.

consistencyCandidates.confidence: source-confirmed architecture; severity requires product decision
consistencyCandidates.observation: My Applications and My Requests are separate navigation destinations and data paths.
consistencyCandidates.implication: Potential naming and tracking confusion; unify presentation only after mapping both domain contracts.

consistencyCandidates.observation: Legacy payment/settlement screens coexist with configured orders and business billing.
consistencyCandidates.implication: Need consistent terminology and entry points without merging incompatible financial states.

consistencyCandidates.observation: Large global stylesheets contain multiple historical style blocks and theme overrides; shared settings/CMS classes cross surfaces.
consistencyCandidates.implication: Changes can affect unrelated pages; inspect computed styles and isolate component/surface ownership.

consistencyCandidates.observation: Many component colors/borders/radii use literal values despite existing root tokens; e-service buttons use a green accent while staff selected tabs use navy.
consistencyCandidates.implication: Define semantic primary/success tokens and compare light/dark/high-contrast rendering.

consistencyCandidates.observation: Native shared dialogs coexist with specialized overlay implementations.
consistencyCandidates.implication: Audit focus, dismissal, stacking, scroll ownership, busy guards and sizing by overlay type.
Establish shared layout breakpoints while retaining content-dependent table/form behavior.

consistencyCandidates.confidence: source-confirmed; runtime keyboard audit needed per widget
consistencyCandidates.observation: Section switching uses role=tab, aria-current and aria-pressed patterns in different places.
consistencyCandidates.implication: Choose navigation vs in-page tabs intentionally and standardize keyboard/focus/panel associations.

consistencyCandidates.observation: Small ui folder exists but most controls/layout patterns remain distributed across feature components.
consistencyCandidates.implication: Build a verified shared primitive library; do not infer that existing utility-class components already form a complete design system.

overhaulConstraints: Preserve URLs and redirect contracts unless a migration is approved.
Preserve resident ownership, staff department boundaries and server permissions.
Never create payment records merely by navigating or previewing a UI.
Use real configured service fields/requirements/fees/workflows; preserve request revision snapshots.
Assessment issue, payment verification and receipt/completion are distinct operations.
Keep adequate hit targets, ghost icon behavior and keyboard focus.
Keep form drafts separate by record and by section; failed saves preserve inputs.
Preserve native date/tel/email behavior and server-backed appointment availability.
Preserve language/theme/contrast/reduced-motion and Philippine date/time handling.

recommendedTarget.status: Proposal; not implemented by this export

verification.existingEvidence: docs/APP_AUDIT.md; browser fixture and domain integration suites in scripts.
verification.limits: Existing tests are evidence for their fixtures and cases; not proof that every possible CMS configuration is visually correct.
